name: Lagertha
subtitle: Warrior Queen
description: Taunt your foes whilst protecting your allies from incoming damage.
lore: A fierce warrior, Lagertha fought alongside Ragnar Lothbrok when his forces attacked the king who had conquered her homeland. She and Ragnar were married for a time, but after he divorced her for another, Lagertha returned home and eventually rose to become queen. In Ryven Asgard, she defends the borders of her lands, but shows little interest in larger conflicts, having tired of battle.
